title.narrative: Contribution to Three Research Studies to Mark Fifty Years of Caritas Bangladesh

description.narrative:
For a year from 25 November 2021, Caritas Bangladesh has been marking its 50th anniversary of working to support emergency response and development work in Bangladesh. With the theme 'Caritas Bangladesh: 50 Years' Journey with Love and Service', the Golden Jubilee celebrations will culminate in a closing programme in November 2022.
To mark the anniversary, Caritas Bangladesh is conducting three research projects into the organisation's contributions during its fifty-year history. These will seek to identify the most successful models of assistance, learnings, and future strategic directions for Caritas Bangladesh, other NGOs, and Bangladesh as a whole, bearing in mind contextual developments and future perspectives. The three research assignments will be carried out by a contracted consultant, focusing on Caritas Bangladesh's work in the fields of Disaster Resilience, Agriculture & Environment, and Educational Services for Entrepreneurship and Self-Sufficiency.
Funds for the Golden Jubilee initiatives are being contributed in part by Caritas Bangladesh staff. To help meet the expenses for the research projects, CAFOD are contributing a one-off grant of £10,000.
